claims.action: No wheat in the building in Phase 1 (client 2026-11-17: blended seasonings only). Keep a supplier gluten statement for every spice; test one finished lot a quarter.

sanitary.sanitary: 304 #4 top, sealed welds, no hollow legs open at the top
304 #4, welds ground, lid gasket FDA silicone
316L fork, 1.5 in Tri-Clamp process connection (sanitary option)
runs clear between formulas; tool-free screw pull
pull and wipe each batch; record finds
FDA-grade HDPE + poly liner per batch
SS contact, tool-free screen and hammer access, dry clean between spices
pull-out tubes, wipe clean each run
screen and deck lift off without tools
316L #4 contact, ground welds, packing glands outside the product zone, 4 in TC flush port
316L contact, cantilevered screw (no product bearing), 2.5 in TC end cap

nfpa: NFPA 652 dust hazard analysis (DHA) before ordering DC-310; send Kst/Pmax and MIE samples of the 3 highest-volume blends to a test lab.
NFPA 61 (agricultural/food dusts): collector outside the building, explosion vent directed away from people, isolation flap valve on the inlet duct.
Bins vent back through the weigh hopper to P1-310; lids gasketed so bins do not puff dust at refill.
Bond and ground the bins, feeders, flexible screw and blender (< 10 ohm); drums are conductive-lined or grounded with a clip at the drum-top sifter.
Housekeeping: dust layer over 1/32 in triggers cleaning; vacuum P1-702 only, never compressed air.
Electrical in the dosing and blending room per the DHA (Class II Div 2 Group G unless shown otherwise); controller P1-225 in a sealed SS enclosure.

haccp.step: Metal detection P1-406 on every finished pack, after labeling
haccp.hazard: Physical: metal from raw spice or equipment wear
haccp.limit: No pack passes containing Fe >= 2.0 mm, non-Fe >= 2.5 mm, 316 SS >= 3.0 mm spheres (set at validation with the jar's foil liner)
haccp.monitor: Test cards through the aperture at start, every 2 h, at end and after any stop; locked reject bin
haccp.correct: Failed test: hold every pack since the last good test, re-run them, find the cause, record
haccp.verify: QA reviews records daily; annual validation
haccp.records: MES pack run record, detector test log

ssop.task: Dry clean pack bench and filler
Blender and flexible screw purge between blends
ssop.method: run screw and blender empty, brush ribbons, vacuum valve; first 5 kg of the next blend back into its own drum

ssop.when: weekly per bin, at the low-level switch
ssop.method: feed to empty, vacuum, wipe cone with dry cloth
ssop.verify: visual; MES closes the bin lot set

ssop.task: Full dry clean of dosing and blending
ssop.method: open blender (locked out), feeders screws out, hopper and drum-top sifter vacuumed

ssop.task: Wet clean (only if a wet event or pest finding)
ssop.method: disassemble, wash, sanitize (quat, no-rinse), dry 12 h before use

prerequisites: Supplier approval with COA per lot; spices bought steam-treated (no kill step in this plant); Salmonella negative in 375 g per COA.
Bin lot control: every refill is scanned into the MES; bins run empty weekly so the lot set per batch stays small.
Sieve (12 mesh) and grate magnet on every batch: screen and magnet checked and recorded per batch.
Net contents: every unit weighed on P1-407; NIST HB 133 lot check in the MES.
Label control: labels printed per run with the batch lot code; first-off label check signed in the MES.
Pest control, glass and brittle plastic register, hygiene vestibule with hand sink P1-704.
